title: Reconciled Recovery State v2 + Recovery Completion Gate

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive to create and execute 32 prompts on full-chat recovery and self-improvement, save results and derive 64 next prompts

problem_or_opportunity: The verified v1 transcript extractor is intentionally first-pass EXTRACTED_UNVERIFIED, but there is no formal machine contract for semantic reconciliation, project partitioning, persistence verification results, write-through/readback, frontier reconstruction and recovery completion before normal production resumes.
proposed_mechanism: Add a separate RECONCILED_RECOVERY_STATE_SCHEMA_v2 downstream of Extract Ledger v1. It must distinguish extraction confidence, authority class, persistence verification and canon status; track project partitions, conflicts/unknowns, verification tasks/results, chat-only dispositions, writes/readbacks and frontier; and expose a fail-closed INGESTION_COMPLETE gate to the next-action resolver.
expected_benefit: Closes the semantic gap between raw transcript extraction and safe automatic continuation, reducing repeated manual reconstruction while preventing false authority promotion.
next_action: Execute N01-N08 and N33-N40 selectively to draft schema v2, state transitions, project partitions and completion/next-action contract; then adversarial review.
notes: PRIMARY meta-integration under ANTI-BEDLAM. Do not package/promote until regression and real corpus pilot evidence exist. Central registry compaction pending safe shard/index migration.
